subject: Subprocessor consolidation: roster + risk worksheet and evidence requests
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@fincoop.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: security@fincoop.com
Date: 2028-06-08T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: updated subprocessor roster + consolidation risk worksheet

Hi Rishi,

We're doing our annual vendor due diligence ahead of a planned internal audit and noticed a note in your last DPA that Redwood is consolidating logging and observability partners later this quarter. To help FinCoop assess impact, could you share the following by EOD Monday (6/12):

- The latest subprocessor roster (spreadsheet) with country of processing for each provider.
- A short risk worksheet that highlights which subprocessors are changing vs being decommissioned, and the expected transfer paths for logs/observability data.
- Any KMS/HSM locations (region-level) for encryption keys used for customer data that may transit during consolidation.

We also need to know if any of the impacted subprocessors will process EU personal data or if routing keeps EU data within EU. If you have a SOC 2 or attestation package for the new vendor(s), please indicate where we can retrieve it (Doc or drive link).

Thanks — appreciate a single consolidated package so our InfoSec team can triage quickly.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of Vendor Risk, FinCoop
elena.martinez@fincoop.com

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@fincoop.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor roster + consolidation risk worksheet

Elena — thanks for the note and the clear asks. We've started pulling the package. Quick summary up front:

- Attached: subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet) — master roster with processing region column, last updated 2028-06-08.
- We're in the middle of consolidating observability from two partners (EdgeMetrics -> LogBridge consolidation). The change affects log ingestion and short-term retention only; long-term storage remains in current archival partner.
- KMS keys: customer encryption keys remain in region-specific KMS; we are not rekeying during consolidation. I've included a high-level KMS mapping (kms_hsm_mapping.pdf) — contains region-level HSM provider names and key residency.

Kimberly and Marissa: assigning to you to review the attached roster and the consolidation risk worksheet draft (I will upload once Kimberly reviews). Can you confirm: 1) whether we can redact vendor contact info for the external package, and 2) whether SOC2 evidence links for the new vendor(s) are public or need NDA before sharing?

Elena — expecting to send the full package (roster + risk worksheet + links) by COB Monday. If you need anything sooner on the KMS mapping, call me directly.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-08T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor roster + consolidation risk worksheet

Thanks Rishi — jumping in. I reviewed the roster and prepared an initial consolidation risk worksheet. Key items:

- Risk worksheet attached: consolidation_risk_worksheet.docx (worksheet includes impact rating, mitigation steps, and a suggested migration freeze window).
- Recommendation: share a redacted roster for external parties (remove vendor POCs and support emails). We should keep vendor names, locations, processing categories, and last-audit-date visible.
- SOC 2 evidence: LogBridge (incoming vendor) has a public SOC 2 summary report; full attestations require an NDA. EdgeMetrics (decommissioned) has a public SOC 2 PDF that we can share. I've flagged which vendors need an NDA in the worksheet.
- KMS mapping is fine to share at region level; do not include key IDs or HSM serials.

Action items for Marissa: can you confirm whether Legal is comfortable with the redaction plan and if we should pre-share an NDA template for FinCoop to sign before sending full attestations?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Sr. Privacy & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@fincoop.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: security@fincoop.com
Date: 2028-06-09T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor roster + consolidation risk worksheet

Rishi / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying points from our InfoSec:

1) For vendors flagged "NDA required" — we can sign a short mutual NDA (one-page) provided by Redwood; please send.
2) For the redacted roster: we need the processing country at the data-type level (e.g., logs from EU customers -> EU processing only). If any processing will route to US for enrichment/analysis, please mark it explicitly.
3) SOC2: a public summary is okay for initial review, but we will request the full attestations for any vendor handling raw logs for EU accounts.

If possible, can you also place the materials into a shared Drive folder and send a link (with viewer-only link) rather than attaching all files to email? Our intake system prefers links.

Thanks — once we have the folder link and NDA, we can turn this around quickly.

Best,
Elena

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@fincoop.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-09T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: updated subprocessor roster + consolidation risk worksheet

Elena — appreciate the clarifying questions. Final notes and links below: 

- Shared folder (viewer-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleSharedDrive (contains subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx, consolidation_risk_worksheet.docx, kms_hsm_mapping.pdf).
- NDA: attaching a one-page mutual NDA template to the Drive folder. Per Kimberly, the NDA covers access to full attestations; once signed we will grant FinCoop the private SOC2 bundles for LogBridge and any other vendor marked "NDA required."
- Processing flags: spreadsheet includes a "data_type_processing_map" column. Flags: EU-customer logs are retained and processed in EU-only ingestion lanes. The consolidation will not move EU raw logs to the US for enrichment. Any enrichment that does occur is performed on anonymized summaries in the US and noted in the "notes" column.
- Timing: we'll keep the shared folder updated. If your team signs the NDA by 6/13, we'll provide the full SOC2 bundles within 48 hours of receiving the signed NDA. Otherwise, public summaries remain available in the folder now.

Attachments in Drive: subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx (master roster), consolidation_risk_worksheet.docx (annotated by Kim), kms_hsm_mapping.pdf

Let me know if you want a short 20-minute sync to walk through the worksheet; happy to set one up this week.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Forwarded attachments (in Drive): subprocessor_roster_v2.xlsx; consolidation_risk_worksheet.docx; kms_hsm_mapping.pdf
